# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_tax_code.py — do not edit manually
# The legislated tax code's draft and bill records and the passage's per-instrument,
# per-good and per-group parts. Schema and rules: docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md, "Draft,
# bill and passage". Country scope; called only by te_tax_bill_effects.txt. Payload is
# removed when its record closes (it is read only while te_tax_dr_on / te_tax_bl_on is 1);
# the two tokens themselves are never removed.

		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_dr_relief_candidates } clear_variable_list = te_tax_dr_relief_candidates }
}

	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_consumer_appliances
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_digital_access
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_digital_assets
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_electricity
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_fabric
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_fine_art
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_fish
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_fruit
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_furniture
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_glass
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_grain
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_groceries
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_liquor
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_luxury_clothes
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_luxury_furniture
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_meat
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_oil
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_opium
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_paper
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_porcelain
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_radios
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_services
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_silk
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_small_arms
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_steamers
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_sugar
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_tea
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_telephones
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_tobacco
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_tourism
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_transportation
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_wine
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_g_wood
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_goods_pver
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_agrel
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_regrel
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_relief_pver
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_wage
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_div
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_land
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_head
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_cons
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_goods
	remove_variable = te_tax_bl_xver_relief
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_bl_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_bl_relief_states }
}

# Slot a: supersession at approval. Called by te_tax_cmd_pass only when the new package
# goes into the other slot. If slot a holds a package (any state) due on or after the
# bill, every provision, good and relief depth the bill touches is dropped from it, so the
# later-approved law wins. The enacted code and its sunsets are never touched here: the
# enacted provision is superseded when the package commences (te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>).
# A package left touching nothing is withdrawn. History kind 8.
te_tax_gen_supersede_a = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_due >= var:te_tax_bl_due
		}
		# The payload exists only while the slot is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = { te_tax_gen_bill_overlaps_a = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_land >= 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_head >= 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_exp value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_succ value = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_cons >= 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_exp value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_succ value = -1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_automobiles >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_automobiles >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_automobiles value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_clippers >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_clippers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_clippers value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_clothes >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_clothes value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_coal >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_coal >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_coal value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_coffee >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_coffee >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_coffee value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_consumer_appliances >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_access >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_access >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_digital_access value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_assets >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_electricity >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_electricity >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_electricity value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_fabric >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_fabric >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fabric value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_fine_art >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_fine_art >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fine_art value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_fish >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_fish >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fish value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_fruit >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_fruit >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fruit value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_furniture >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_furniture value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_glass >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_glass >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_glass value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_grain >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_grain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_grain value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_groceries >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_groceries >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_groceries value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_liquor >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_liquor >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_liquor value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_clothes >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_luxury_clothes value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_furniture >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_luxury_furniture value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_meat >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_meat >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_meat value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_oil >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_oil >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_oil value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_opium >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_opium >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_opium value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_paper >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_paper >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_paper value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_porcelain >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_porcelain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_porcelain value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_radios >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_radios >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_radios value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_services >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_services >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_services value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_silk >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_silk >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_silk value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_small_arms >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_small_arms >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_small_arms value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_steamers >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_steamers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_steamers value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_sugar >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_sugar >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_sugar value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_tea >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_tea >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_tea value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_telephones >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_telephones >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_telephones value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_tobacco >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_tobacco >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_tobacco value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_tourism >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_tourism value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_transportation >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_transportation >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_transportation value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_wine >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_wine >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_wine value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_wood >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_g_wood >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_wood value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_agrel >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_agrel value = -1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_regrel >= 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set value = 0 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
			}
			te_tax_history_push = { KIND = 8 SLOT = a }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX superseded slot=a: a later approval replaced provisions due on or after its own; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
			if = {
				limit = { te_tax_gen_package_empty_a = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_on value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 0 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
				debug_log = "TE_TAX superseded slot=a: every provision replaced; the slot is free; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
			}
		}
	}
}

# bill, every provision, good and relief depth the bill touches is dropped from it, so the

			}
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes >= 0 var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes value = -1 } }

			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_clippers >= 0 var:te_tax_pb_g_clippers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_clippers value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_clothes >= 0 var:te_tax_pb_g_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_clothes value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_coal >= 0 var:te_tax_pb_g_coal >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_coal value = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:te_tax_bl_g_coffee >= 0 var:te_tax_pb_g_coffee >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_coffee value = -1 } }

				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_regrel value = -1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_regrel_states_set value = 0 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
			}
			te_tax_history_push = { KIND = 8 SLOT = b }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX superseded slot=b: a later approval replaced provisions due on or after its own; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
			if = {
				limit = { te_tax_gen_package_empty_b = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_on value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 0 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
				debug_log = "TE_TAX superseded slot=b: every provision replaced; the slot is free; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
			}
		}
	}
}

# Planned versions: an approval changes the baseline of every provision group it touches,
# so a draft written against the old one must be rebased before it is introduced.
te_tax_gen_bump_pver = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_wage add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_div add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_land add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_head add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_cons add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_gen_bill_touches_goods = yes }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_goods add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_bl_agrel >= 0
				var:te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pver_relief add = 1 }
	}
}

# Releases every commitment (a new bill or revision; the bill closing).
te_tax_gen_reset_commitments = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev value = -1 }
}

# The support snapshot (te_tax_refresh_support, while a bill is open): each interest group's
# reasons, its score (their sum, clamped), and its commitment to the bill's current
# revision. A group committed to this revision stays committed; otherwise it commits at
# te_tax_commit_threshold, draws a red line at te_tax_redline_threshold, else is
# persuadable (0). Promises and trust are 0 until Tasks 12-13. A group the country lacks
# is zeroed.
te_tax_gen_refresh_support = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_armed_forces }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_mat value = te_tax_mat_armed_forces }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_armed_forces }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_gov value = te_tax_gov_armed_forces }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces value = var:te_tax_sr_armed_forces_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces add = var:te_tax_sr_armed_forces_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces add = var:te_tax_sr_armed_forces_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces add = var:te_tax_sr_armed_forces_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces add = var:te_tax_sr_armed_forces_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces add = var:te_tax_sr_armed_forces_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 1
						var:te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_armed_forces >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_armed_forces <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_armed_forces_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_armed_forces value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_devout }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_mat value = te_tax_mat_devout }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_devout }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_gov value = te_tax_gov_devout }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout value = var:te_tax_sr_devout_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout add = var:te_tax_sr_devout_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout add = var:te_tax_sr_devout_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout add = var:te_tax_sr_devout_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout add = var:te_tax_sr_devout_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout add = var:te_tax_sr_devout_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_devout } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_devout = 1
						var:te_tax_com_devout_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_devout >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_devout <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_devout_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_devout value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_devout_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_industrialists }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_mat value = te_tax_mat_industrialists }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_industrialists }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_gov value = te_tax_gov_industrialists }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists value = var:te_tax_sr_industrialists_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists add = var:te_tax_sr_industrialists_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists add = var:te_tax_sr_industrialists_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists add = var:te_tax_sr_industrialists_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists add = var:te_tax_sr_industrialists_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists add = var:te_tax_sr_industrialists_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 1
						var:te_tax_com_industrialists_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_industrialists >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_industrialists <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_industrialists_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_industrialists value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_mat value = te_tax_mat_intelligentsia }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_intelligentsia }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_gov value = te_tax_gov_intelligentsia }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia value = var:te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia add = var:te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia add = var:te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia add = var:te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia add = var:te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia add = var:te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 1
						var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_intelligentsia >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_intelligentsia <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_intelligentsia_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_landowners }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_mat value = te_tax_mat_landowners }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_landowners }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_gov value = te_tax_gov_landowners }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners value = var:te_tax_sr_landowners_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners add = var:te_tax_sr_landowners_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners add = var:te_tax_sr_landowners_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners add = var:te_tax_sr_landowners_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners add = var:te_tax_sr_landowners_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners add = var:te_tax_sr_landowners_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_landowners = 1
						var:te_tax_com_landowners_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_landowners >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_landowners <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_landowners_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_landowners value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_landowners_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_mat value = te_tax_mat_petty_bourgeoisie }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_petty_bourgeoisie }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_gov value = te_tax_gov_petty_bourgeoisie }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie value = var:te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie add = var:te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie add = var:te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie add = var:te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie add = var:te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie add = var:te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 1
						var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_petty_bourgeoisie_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_rural_folk }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_mat value = te_tax_mat_rural_folk }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_rural_folk }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_gov value = te_tax_gov_rural_folk }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk value = var:te_tax_sr_rural_folk_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk add = var:te_tax_sr_rural_folk_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk add = var:te_tax_sr_rural_folk_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk add = var:te_tax_sr_rural_folk_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk add = var:te_tax_sr_rural_folk_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk add = var:te_tax_sr_rural_folk_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 1
						var:te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_rural_folk >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_rural_folk <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_rural_folk_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_rural_folk value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ig:ig_trade_unions }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_mat value = te_tax_mat_trade_unions }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_ideo value = te_tax_ideo_trade_unions }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_fisc value = te_tax_fiscal_reason }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_gov value = te_tax_gov_trade_unions }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions value = var:te_tax_sr_trade_unions_mat }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions add = var:te_tax_sr_trade_unions_ideo }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions add = var:te_tax_sr_trade_unions_fisc }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions add = var:te_tax_sr_trade_unions_gov }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions add = var:te_tax_sr_trade_unions_prom }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions add = var:te_tax_sr_trade_unions_trust }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions min = -100 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions } }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 1
						var:te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_trade_unions >= te_tax_commit_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_sup_trade_unions <= te_tax_redline_threshold }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions value = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_mat value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_ideo value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_fisc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_gov value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_prom value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sr_trade_unions_trust value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_sup_trade_unions value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev value = -1 }
	}
}

# At passage, each group that opposed the bill (score below 0, not committed to this
# revision) disapproves for six months, through the shared ig_approval_effect.
te_tax_gen_oppose_approval = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_sup_armed_forces < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 1 var:te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_armed_forces MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_devout
			var:te_tax_sup_devout < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_devout = 1 var:te_tax_com_devout_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_devout MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_industrialists
			var:te_tax_sup_industrialists < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 1 var:te_tax_com_industrialists_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_industrialists MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_sup_intelligentsia < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 1 var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_intelligentsia MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_landowners
			var:te_tax_sup_landowners < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_landowners = 1 var:te_tax_com_landowners_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_landowners MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 1 var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_petty_bourgeoisie MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_sup_rural_folk < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 1 var:te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_rural_folk MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_sup_trade_unions < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 1 var:te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_trade_unions MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
}
